# @ewo (vendored)

Generated by Folio (`npm run vendor`, folio b6d395e). Don't edit these files here: change them in Folio and vendor again.

- `tokens/tokens.css`: the shared custom properties (`--ewo-*`), in `@layer ewo`. Import it first (before `@import "tailwindcss"` too); the project then sets the ones it differs in, and anything it declares wins over the layer.
- `tokens/projects.css`: each project's colour (`--ewo-project-<name>`), and `data-ewo-project` to make one the accent.
- `tokens/bundle.css`: both of the above in one file, for a page without a build step.
- `tokens/fonts.css`, `tokens/index.css`, `tokens/fonts/`: only in projects that take the fonts from here.
- `elements/<name>.js`: one custom element per module (`<ewo-switch>`, `<ewo-segmented>`, …). Import only the ones used; each defines itself once.
- `elements/theme-shift.js`: `themeShift(apply)`, a theme change under a short blur of the page (no element).
- `elements/scroll-lock.js`: `lockScroll()`, the page stops scrolling until the function it returns is called; `<ewo-sheet>` takes it while open, an app's own `<dialog>` can too (no element).
- `elements/press.js`: `pressFeedback({ preset })`, a visible answer to every tap on a phone (`data-pressed`, calm or lively); call it once in main.ts (no element).
- `elements/waiting.js`: `track(control, (signal) => action, { label })`, the wait after a tap at the control that started it: held pressed until the answer, the working mark at 150 ms, words at 1.2 s, `Taking longer` at 6 s, `Try again` at 12 s; `configureWaiting({ mark })` for a game's own mark (`plans/waiting-states.md` in the workspace).
- `elements/connection.js`: `<ewo-connection state>`, the room's connection in a pill when it's worth saying (connecting after 400 ms, reconnecting after 1.5 s, then `Connected again`).
- `elements/emblem.js` and `elements/emblem-maker.js`: players' emblems (`<ewo-emblem theme value>`, `<ewo-emblem-maker>`), themes `heraldry` (Vollmond's shield), `doodle` (Kritzle's face), `tag` (Schätzle's price tag), `agent` (CDNMS's agent) and `token`. `elements/emblem-core.js` has no DOM: an app's server imports it to check what a player sent (`cleanEmblem(theme, value)`). `plans/emblems.md` in the workspace.
- `elements/settings-button.js` and `elements/settings-basics.js`: the settings button (the sliders icon) and the Language and Theme rows every app's settings begin with (`plans/settings-alignment.md` in the workspace).
- `elements/react.d.ts`, `elements/svelte.d.ts`: JSX and Svelte typings for the elements.
- `elements/custom-elements.json`: the elements' API, for editors and tooling.
